mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet refinishing take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet refinishing project depends on the size of your kitchen and the complexity of the work. A typical kitchen cabinet refinishing project can take anywhere from a few days to a couple of weeks from start to finish. This includes preparation, sanding, priming, painting or staining, and curing time. We will provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific needs.
